description_en: Modifies the callback URL information for a phone number
description_zh: 修改号码回调地址信息
kebab_example: aliyun cams update-phone-webhook --cust-space-id 2934839388494930000 --http-flag Y --queue-flag N --phone-number 8613800000000 --status-callback-url http://www.aliyun.com --up-callback-url http://aliyun.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePhoneWebhook

parameters.help_en: The SpaceId of the ISV sub-customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use HTTP to receive receipts. Valid values:

Y: Yes.

N: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用HTTP方式接收回执。取值：

Y：是

N：否
parameters.name: http_flag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a queue to receive receipts. Valid values:

Y: Yes.

N: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用队列方式接收回执。取值：

Y：是

N：否
parameters.name: queue_flag

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the HTTP-based status report
parameters.help_zh: HTTP方式状态报告接口回调地址
parameters.name: status_callback_url

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for the HTTP-based upstream message
parameters.help_zh: HTTP方式上行消息接口回调地址
parameters.name: up_callback_url
